project.title: Microbiomes of anaerobic membrane bioreactor treating organic solid waste
project.description: Sludge and biofilm microbiomes of anaerobic membrane bioreactor (An-MBR) treating organic solid waste were analyzed by high-throughput Illumina sequencing of 16S and 18S rRNA genes.
project.center_name: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology
